    StartersSummerville fried okraCornmeal crusted fried okra rounds with hot sauceHow to make it500g okra, sliced into rounds150ml buttermilk150g cornmeal50g plain flour1 L vegetable oil, for frying2 tbsp hot saucesalt and pepper, to tasteToss the okra in buttermilk.Mix the cornmeal, flour, salt and pepper and coat the okra.Fry in the oil at 180°C for 3 minutes, in batches, until crisp.Serve with hot sauce.Farmhouse pan cornbread, honey butterCorn and jalapeño batter in hot cast iron, flaky saltHow to make itAs written, serves 4Golden cornbread baked in a hot cast iron pan with corn kernels and jalapeño, served warm in wedges with whipped honey butter and flaky salt.Heat the oven to 210°C with a 25cm cast iron pan inside.Mix 200g fine polenta, 150g plain flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt.Whisk 300ml buttermilk, 2 eggs and 80g melted butter, stir into the dry mix with 150g corn kernels and 1 chopped jalapeño.Add 20g butter to the hot pan, pour in the batter and bake 20 to 25 minutes.Beat 100g soft butter with 2 tbsp honey and serve with the warm wedges.Muncher's corn fritters with jalapeño ranchSweet corn fritters fried golden, jalapeño ranch for dippingHow to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsEcto-1 double smash burgersSmashed beef patties with American cheese, pickles and burger sauce, with friesHow to make it800g beef chuck mince8 slices of American cheese4 burger buns8 dill pickle slices1 brown onion, sliced4 tbsp mayonnaise2 tbsp sweet relish1kg crinkle-cut potatoes2 L vegetable oil, for fryingFry the potatoes in the oil once at a gentle heat until soft, drain, then fry again at a higher heat until crisp.Shape the mince into balls. Mix the mayonnaise and relish for burger sauce.Smash the balls into thin patties on a smoking griddle and add cheese.Stack two patties per bun with pickles, onion and sauce.Oklahoma chicken fried steak with gravyTenderised steak fried crisp, peppery white gravy, mash and green beansHow to make itAs written, serves 4Tenderised beef steak dredged twice in seasoned flour, fried crunchy and smothered in peppery white country gravy, with mashed potato and green beans.Pound 4 x 150g thin beef minute steaks.Season 200g plain flour with salt, pepper and 1 tsp garlic powder.Dip the steaks in flour, then in 2 eggs beaten with 200ml buttermilk, then back in the flour.Shallow fry in 1cm oil at 180°C for 3 minutes a side and drain.Pour off all but 3 tbsp fat, stir in 3 tbsp of the flour, whisk in 500ml milk and simmer until thick with lots of black pepper.Serve with mash and buttered beans.SweetsToasted marshmallow pieChocolate ganache in a cookie crust, topped with a tall marshmallow meringue, torchedHow to make it250g digestive biscuits, crushed100g butter, melted200g dark chocolate200ml thickened cream3 egg whites150g caster sugarMix the crushed biscuits with the melted butter and press into a pie tin.Melt the chocolate with the cream, pour in and chill to set.Whisk the egg whites with the sugar over hot water, then beat stiff.Pile tall and torch until blistered.Mini
